B0.input: per-PRN 9 prompt-normalized Method-A correlation taps; [batch, 12, 9] history predicts next [9] target
B0.evidence_before_binomial_tail: per-PRN standardized 9-tap prediction residual exists before RMSE; standard scorer persists RMSE/MAE rather than signed vector
B0.window: 1.0 s window, 0.5 s stride, target window_start_s; available at window end
B0.normalization: train-split feature mean/std in frozen checkpoint
B0.threshold: cleanStatic+cleanDynamic PRN quantiles -> binomial tail -> EWMA q99

M1.input: raw pre-correlation interleaved int16 I/Q features: power, phase increments/coherence, PSD entropy/flatness/bands, autocorrelation, amplitude statistics
M1.evidence_before_scalar: PCA AR innovation vector and its RMSE; feature-level robust drift vector
M1.window: 10 ms raw-IQ block at 0.5 s stride; recording-relative window_start_s
M1.normalization: fit-prefix mean/std before PCA; robust median/MAD for residual and level scores
M1.threshold: per-recording fit-prefix q99 of causal EWMA ratios
